title: Correct height calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute h = 2.5R = 1 m for part (1).

title: Correct friction work
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute W_f = -0.8 J for part (2).

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the work-energy theorem correctly, relating initial potential energy to kinetic energy at C minus work done by friction.

title: Centripetal force condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the correct force balance at point C using Newton's second law and centripetal acceleration.

title: Sign convention consistency
description: Important Criteria: The student must consistently treat work done by friction as negative when it removes mechanical energy.

title: Unit analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student should include proper units (meters, joules) in intermediate steps and final answers.

title: Incorrect normal force
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses mg - N = mv²/R instead of N + mg = mv²/R for part (2) at point C.

title: Missing friction work term
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student omits the work done by friction in the energy equation for part (2).

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student reports W_f as positive 0.8 J instead of -0.8 J.
